Declarations for app name, callbacks, stages, tiles, and actions.

# Purpose
This header file defines the main registry data for the `fddev` application. It sets the application and binary names, then declares external callback, stage, tile, and action objects that are used by the program at run time. The `CALLBACKS`, `STAGES`, `TILES`, and `ACTIONS` arrays collect these objects into null-terminated lists so other code can iterate over the available topology objects, configuration stages, run tiles, and command actions. It also includes `configure.h`, which provides the types used by the configuration stage list.
